units.source_text: 此外，佐田家的“丸太”商号，虽说生意已日渐惨淡，甚至连店内的陈旧设备也无力更新，

en.t: Besides, although business under the Sada family's Maruta trade name had grown worse by the day, and they could not even afford to replace the old equipment in the shop,

units.source_text: 但毕竟是中京的批发商，不同于只拥有三台手织机的纺织作坊。

en.t: it was still, after all, a wholesaler in Nakagyo, unlike a weaving workshop with only three handlooms.

units.source_text: 一个雇工都没有，光靠家庭手工，生活也可想而知了。

en.t: With not a single hired worker and only the family's own hand labor to depend on, one could well imagine what their life was like.

units.source_text: 这从秀男的母亲浅子那副表情，以及简陋的厨房就看得出来。

en.t: This could be seen from the expression on the face of Hideo's mother, Asako, and from the plain, meager kitchen.

units.source_text: 即便秀男是长子，但同他们商量商量，说不定会同意让秀男当千重子的入赘女婿。

en.t: Even though Hideo was the eldest son, if they discussed it with his family, they might perhaps agree to let him become Chieko's adopted son-in-law.
